description: This file contains the implementation of a service (`ScreenRecordService`) for capturing screen recordings on macOS using ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation. It includes error handling, configuration, and management of the recording process, along with a helper class (`StreamRecorder`) that handles the AVAssetWriter setup and writing.

classes.name: ScreenRecordError
classes.description: An enumeration defining possible errors during screen recording, such as no displays available, invalid screen index, no frames captured, and write failures.

classes.name: StreamRecorder
classes.description: A helper class that manages writing video and optional audio data to an MP4 file using AVAssetWriter, conforming to SCStreamOutput and SCStreamDelegate protocols.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Starts a screen recording session on a specified display index, with options for duration, frame rate, audio inclusion, and output path. Manages the capture lifecycle and returns the recorded file path and audio presence.

methods.name: stream(_:didStopWithError:)
methods.description: Handles errors when a screen capture stream stops unexpectedly.

methods.name: stream(_:didOutputSampleBuffer:of:)
methods.description: Processes sample buffers from the capture stream, delegating to video or audio handlers.

methods.name: finish()
methods.description: Finalizes writing the captured data asynchronously, ensuring all data is written and resources are released.
